$comment: Lighthouse CI config. See https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse-ci. LCP/CLS use Google Core Web Vitals 'good' thresholds; performance score starts at warn=0.85 and will be tightened (or relaxed, with rationale) once we collect ~10 main-branch baseline runs. INP is intentionally omitted — Lighthouse can't measure interaction latency without user actions. The CI workflow starts `vite preview` and waits for it via `wait-on` BEFORE invoking lhci, so this config does not use startServerCommand/startServerReadyPattern (the latter was flaky against vite preview's non-tty stdout).
